reviewed_logic: Only ten exact existing target labels are eligible, and only unambiguous PASSED/FLAKY console summaries select existing local files. SKIPPED/NOT_REPORTED/ambiguous/failed targets do not turn old directories into successful-case evidence.

Current invocation's owned console file drives selection. Cached markers, original status lines, absent/conflicting results, requested config/filter/cache/retry/timeout/shard flags, collection-time Git identity and per-file mtime/hash/bytes are retained explicitly.
New selected-target-test-logs scope/schema does not call successful logs failed. It explicitly disclaims complete case inventory, test-start identity and independent per-file invocation binding.

Actual test command construction/execution/PIPESTATUS capture is byte-identical. No test rerun, new target execution, downloading policy, timeout, cache, retry, production permission or dependency change.

Collection remains diagnostic and preserves original Bazel exit status 0 or nonzero. Existing failed-target tail/archive path is retained. Existing configured upload root already includes the new directory.

Copied original safe traversal/streaming/error machinery is byte-identical except selected-mode mtime provenance. Original 13 test method bodies remain byte-identical, including R1 effective-argv and LF fixture fixes; three meaningful evidence-copy/failure controls are added.
limitations: Not yet syntax-checked or executed on the native source.
A locally absent remote-success log remains absent. No original TUI/Queue/Core/Hook/etc case is declared PASS by this patch alone.
An absent cached marker is not proof of local or fresh remote execution. NOT_REPORTED is not labeled filtered/skipped without separate evidence.
Windows paths retain the existing MSYS conversion exclusion mechanism, but original Windows runtime must still run.

A first root method-comparison parser missed multiline Python signatures; the final comparison recognizes all 13 originals and all 16 final definitions. No source/test result changed because of that review correction.
